svg.text: 3 pages · light + dark · dashed strips are mock annotations, not product UI

g.title: CRWM-01-light — Change creation (narrow) (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes/new · 390px creation keeps title/intent fields, three subject rows with Repair on the invalid row, add-subject actions, collapsed-but-present Claims, billable warning, progress and a sticky Save draft / Discard footer

g.text: One form — save an incomplete draft at any point.
intent · High-risk carts are captured too readily.
✕ no candidate commit — the draft still saves
a URL resolves to exact commits — never identity itself
collapsed detail is still on this page — nothing is removed
Save draft and the cost warning never hide.

svg.text: CRWM-01 — Change creation (narrow) route: /t/acme/changes/new params: none pattern: R-FORM
states: all sections stack; the invalid subject keeps its inline error and Repair; Claims collapse without removal; Save draft and the billable warning never hide behind the sticky footer
links: Save draft → new Change Overview; + Add subject → PR URL or exact commits; Edit ▸ → Claims section

g.title: CRWM-02-light — Change review (narrow) (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes/change_01/review · 390px review keeps the mini shared header with separate state badges and next-action line, the Change-level composer, an open thread with reply + stale notice, a resolved thread, and the full Submit review panel

g.text: next: CLAIM-2 Evidence · CLAIM-3 PII · your review requested
Holding 2.2% of carts is more than we
Reply — eval run 11:21Z has the effect…
! stale revision — reload keeps your draft
j.reyes — cutoff now reads the Policy Card.
Request changes — blocks until a new revision

svg.text: CRWM-02 — Change review (narrow) route: /t/acme/changes/change_01/review params: none pattern: R-CHANGE
states: header keeps lifecycle/verification/approval badges and the next line; reply composer and stale-revision recovery stack; Submit review keeps all three decisions and the exact revision
links: thread anchors → Verification / subject; Submit review → recorded decision

g.title: CRWM-03-light — Subject review (narrow) (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes/change_01/subjects/subject_api · 390px subject review keeps identity, file chips with position and Prev/Next, the sideways-scrolling read-only diff with both anchors, a line-anchored Start discussion composer, provider link and sticky Review changes

g.text: + on a line starts a revision-aware discussion
rank.rs:121 — does Low band stay covered?

svg.text: CRWM-03 — Subject review (narrow) route: /t/acme/changes/change_01/subjects/subject_api params: ?file=src/capture/rank.rs pattern: R-DIFF
states: identity and exact commits stay in the header; diff scrolls sideways in place; line 121 composer is revision-aware; Review changes stays in the sticky footer; no edit or merge
links: file chips → ?file=…; Open → Review thread; Provider ↗ → PR #4412; Review changes ▾ → submission
